The '''BF-4F Warrior''' was a type of small [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The BF-4F Warrior appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet. It was a reward for players who invited three friends to play the game using the Refer a Friend system.
